{"metadata":{"description":"Content-addressed receipts for skills actually loaded by DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333712447","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-capability-receipt","slug":"dongsheng123132/dsh-capability-receipt","topics":["agent-skills","ai-agent","capability","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","mcp","provenance","sha256","supply-chain-security"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Content-addressed receipts for skills actually loaded by DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-capability-receipt"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · hequbing.com**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"`dsh-capability-receipt` proves which skill DeepSeek Harness actually loaded. It hashes the effectiv"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"e instruction body returned by `ctx.skills.get()`, records the winning provider/source/invocation po"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"licy, and—when the resource base is local—hashes a bounded resource-directory closure. It can then c"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ompare that runtime observation with hashes pinned by a trusted source artifact and write a determin"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"istic content-addressed receipt."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This is deliberately not another skill package format, dependency resolver, installer, registry, eva"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"luator, per-turn summary, or event audit ledger. Use pack-agent for packaging and distribution; use "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"this plugin for the missing last hop between a fixed source artifact and the effective capability in"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"in for the missing last hop between a fixed source artifact and the effective capability inside DSH."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Version 0.3.0 is host-neutral: the DSH entry does not import a private ToolRuntime helper and expose"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"s no default export, so the stock Cordis loader preserves the module-level `inject = ['tools', 'skil"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"ls']` contract in the built `web` profile."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## DSH tools"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- `dsh_capability_receipt_inspect`: returns structural fields and hashes without returning skill ins"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"tructions, metadata, or absolute paths.
- `dsh_capability_receipt_issue`: requires `expectedContentS"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ha256`, accepts optional resource/provider/source/invocation expectations, and writes only beneath a"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"n explicit workspace-relative `artifactDir`.
- `dsh_capability_receipt_issue_from_pack`: reads a wor"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"kspace-relative pack-agent `agent-pack/lock/v1`, recomputes pack-agent's directory and portable-bund"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"le skill hashes, requires the effective DSH body to equal the locked `SKILL.md` body, checks optiona"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"l provider/source/invocation expectations, and writes the same receipt format."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"The plugin observes but never executes the target capability. A receipt fails closed when the DSH ca"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"talog is incomplete or changes during observation, when the loaded definition disagrees with its cat"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"alog entry, when an expectation mismatches, or when resources cannot be safely closed."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## MCP proof surface"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The formal `.mcp.json` declaration exposes two stdio tools:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- `capability_receipt_inspect_lock` parses one explicit inline pack-agent lock and returns only iden"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"tities and hashes.
- `capability_receipt_verify_recorded` compares an explicit recorded DSH content/"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"resource digest envelope with that lock and returns a content-addressed verdict."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"This MCP surface is intentionally proof-only and in-memory. It cannot inspect the live DSH registry,"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" read files, access the network, execute a capability, or write a receipt. Live observation and arti"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"fact issuance remain DSH ToolRuntime responsibilities, sharing the same core verifier."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## pack-agent bridge"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"After pack-agent has exported/installed a pack, issue a receipt against its lock without translating"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" it into another manifest:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Required inputs are `skillName`, `packLockPath`, and `artifactDir`. The lock's `ref` and `lockedAt` "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"are not copied into the receipt. The bridge currently pins the hash contract observed at pack-agent "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"commit `e2db1f8f56b74b64597a01175c810358f2c0b450`; the fixture records the exact upstream Git blobs."},{"id":"p17s4","text":" Both directory-source and portable-bundle path forms are recognized, and the matched form is explic"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"it in `verification.matchedHashMode`."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install in DSH"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Pin a reviewed commit in an isolated DSH profile:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The package declares its DSH bundle and ships `cordis.patch.yml`, so a successful plugin install add"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"s the layer to that profile automatically."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Offline receipt verification"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The CLI never discovers or loads skills. It only verifies an already-issued artifact:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"stdout is one JSON result. Failures go to stderr and exit with code `4`; usage errors exit with code"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"t is one JSON result. Failures go to stderr and exit with code `4`; usage errors exit with code `1`."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Resource safety"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Directory closure defaults to at most 256 regular files, 1 MiB per file, and 8 MiB total. Symbolic l"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"inks and special files are rejected. URL and opaque resource bases are disclosed as unavailable rath"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"er than fetched. Limits may be lowered or raised in trusted DSH plugin configuration."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Requires Node.js 22 or newer. No install lifecycle scripts are used."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Security boundary"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"A verified receipt proves equality with caller-supplied expectations or one pack-agent lock at one D"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"SH runtime observation. A pack lock is evidence input, not a signature or trust anchor: the bridge v"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"erifies its equality to runtime files and the effective body, but does not prove who produced the lo"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"ck. It also does not prove that the skill is useful or safe, that the capability was executed, or th"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"at external model/tool behavior was correct. Pin trusted source commits and preserve their review/ev"},{"id":"p32s6","text":"aluation evidence separately."}],"truncated":false}
